name: JW Marriott Clearwater Beach Resort & Spa
positioning: Beachfront resort on the quieter south end of Clearwater Beach, with an exclusive guest beach, an 11th-floor rooftop pool and Spa by JW
best_for: Families wanting multi-bedroom Residences with kitchenettes and a kids club
Beach lovers who want a quieter stretch of Clearwater Beach

facts.text: The resort sits on the quieter south end of Clearwater Beach.
The resort is on the southern end of Clearwater Beach, near the Clearwater Marine Aquarium.
The rooftop pool is on the 11th floor.
Spa by JW has locker rooms, a steam room and a sauna.
Each Residence has a kitchenette, an in-room washer and dryer, and a living area with floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors.
Suites feature plush carpeting, touches of turquoise in a largely eggshell palette, landscape paintings and spacious private balconies.
Wellness classes include beachfront morning meditation, yoga and qi gong.
Guests can explore Clearwater Beach with complimentary bike rentals.
Water activities include eco kayak tours, kayaks and stand-up paddleboarding lessons.
Latitude 28 is open for breakfast and dinner with indoor and outdoor seating.
The closest airport is St Petersburg-Clearwater International Airport.

highlights.text: The rooftop pool has sweeping Gulf views, with cabanas and loungers.
Guests have an exclusive beach with chairs and umbrellas, with cabanas available as an upgrade.
The resort offers one-, two- and three-bedroom Residences.
The Hideaway Hangout kids club is designed for children ages 5 to 10.
The Deep End is an 11th-floor rooftop bar with craft cocktails and Gulf views.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Pets are not allowed at the beach, pool or restaurants.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the resort's luxury positioning.
